criteria.criterion: The desk menu has these 14 entries: Today, Tasks, Leads, Customers, Quotes, Communications, Rentals, Schedule, Repairs, Equipment, Money, Taxes, Settings and More. Owner and admin see all 14, staff see only the ones they can open, and the phone bottom bar uses the same names as the menu.
criteria.evidence: src/lib/desk-navigation.ts now lists exactly 14 entries (Today, Tasks, Leads, Customers, Quotes, Communications, Rentals, Schedule, Repairs, Equipment, Money, Taxes, Settings, More); staff get the 10 they can open with no finance words in the serialized menu, and the phone bottom bar uses the same names. tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts, tests/desk-navigation.test.ts, tests/e2-app-shell.test.tsx and e2e/desk-workspace.spec.ts.

criteria.criterion: Dispatch, Jobs and Driver view are one Schedule entry with three views; Parts, Purchases and Purchase orders are tabs under Equipment; Revenue, Fleet, Reports and Business overview are tabs under Money. Every old address still opens, and the right menu entry stays highlighted on each.
criteria.evidence: src/lib/desk-sections.ts and src/components/desk/section-tabs*.tsx add role-filtered tabs through small layouts (Schedule: Dispatch board, Jobs, Driver view; Equipment: Inventory, Parts, Purchases, Purchase orders; Money: Billing, Revenue, Fleet, Reports, Business overview). No address moved; DESK_NAV_ALIASES keeps the right entry highlighted, proven for every alias in tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts and tests/w8-section-tabs.test.tsx.

criteria.criterion: Suppliers, Growth signals, Launch list, System health, Privacy requests and Activity are on a More page that lists only what the signed-in role may open (enforced where the list is built); developer-only screens such as the preview storage check are not in the owner's menu or on More.
criteria.evidence: src/app/desk/more/page.tsx lists Suppliers, Growth signals, Launch list, System health, Privacy requests and Activity through deskMoreLinks, filtered by role on the server (staff see Activity only); the preview storage check is in neither the menu, the tabs nor More and still returns not-found outside test storage. Covered by tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts and tests/w8-section-tabs.test.tsx.

criteria.criterion: A plain-words check runs with the lint step in CI: a reviewed list of banned phrases (such as taxability matrix, remit, election, cents, raw status codes, jurisdiction) is refused on owner screen text with a plain replacement shown, any allowlist entry needs a written reason, and the wording it finds today is fixed.
criteria.evidence: scripts/check-owner-wording.mjs runs with npm run lint (and in CI's static job): banned phrases with plain replacements on owner screen text and To do text, an allowlist that requires a written reason, and 18 hard words fixed (jurisdiction, remit/remittance, a raw status code). scripts/check-owner-wording.test.mjs is part of check:preflight.

criteria.criterion: Every menu entry, tab and More link opens a page that exists, checked against the route list for owner, admin and staff.
criteria.evidence: tests/w8-menu-sections.test.ts checks every menu entry, tab and More link for owner, admin and staff against the e2e route inventory (/desk/more was added); the new page is also in the browser accessibility inventory.

criteria.criterion: On the day a filing period closes, Today shows "File and pay $X on <site> by <date>" (or "File a $0 return on <site> by <date>", because a $0 return still has to be filed), with "(overdue)" after the legal deadline, and it opens that return.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/tax/filing-attention.ts works out each closed period's total with the same filing packet the return page uses and src/domains/exceptions/rules.ts titles the To do "File and pay $X on SUTS by <date>" or "File a $0 return on SUTS by <date>", adding "(overdue)" after the legal date; it opens the return. tests/w9-filing-autopilot-integration.test.ts (real Postgres) proves the amount, the $0 case, the overdue wording and that a filed return leaves the list.

criteria.criterion: Owner reminder emails go out the owner-chosen days before the due date (starting 7 and 2), on the due day, and every business day while the return is overdue.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/tax/filing-reminders.ts now emails every business day once a return is past its legal deadline (the before-due days stay the owner-editable 7 and 2, and the due day stays). tests/tax-filing-reminders-integration.test.ts asserts the new daily rule.

criteria.criterion: "I filed and paid it" asks only for the date paid and the confirmation number; the filed date and a different amount are optional extras (a different amount still needs a reason). Saving it locks the return and marks the equipment use tax on it as filed.
criteria.evidence: The return page's form is now "I filed and paid it": date paid and confirmation number, with filed date and a different amount in an optional section; markPeriodFiled defaults the filed date to the paid date and the amount to the calculated amount, still refuses a different amount without a reason and a blank confirmation number, locks the return and marks the equipment use tax filed. Real-Postgres tests in tests/w9-filing-autopilot-integration.test.ts and the existing tax-filing-finalization and tax-return-actions suites.

criteria.criterion: A nightly check raises a high-priority System health issue when a closed filing period has no return on the list, and clears it once the return exists, so nothing is ever left silently unfiled.
criteria.evidence: collectSystemIssueInputs compares each active account's filing calendar with its saved periods and raises the high TAX_PERIOD_MISSING issue (rendered and linked to the returns list) when a closed period has no return, clearing it once the rows exist. Real-Postgres test in tests/w9-filing-autopilot-integration.test.ts and tests/system-issue-sweep-integration.test.ts.

planComparison: Actual production change (about +496/-83 across 30 files) is below the 650-line estimate because tabs are small layouts around existing screens and the filing machinery already existed; both subsections, their boundaries and all frozen acceptance are unchanged and fully delivered. W-10 was not started.
newEngineering: 14-entry role-filtered menu with section tabs (Schedule, Equipment, Money) and a More page, plain-words check with script tests and 18 wording fixes, amount-aware filing To do wording, daily overdue reminders, simplified filed-and-paid recording, nightly missing-period system issue
relatedWorkDecision: W-8 and W-9 are the next two items in approved order and are both owner-facing wording and workflow over existing screens and tax records, with no schema change and no moved routes; W-10 (File now panel and filled DR 0252 PDF) is a separate compliance document outcome left for the next bundle.
